Author: daemitus, MidoriKami, FinaXIV
Name: ezWondrousTails2
Description: This plugin prints the probability of getting a row in Wondrous Tails to the in-game display along with the average probability of what would happen if you shuffled. Updated fork of ezWondrousTails by daemitus and MidoriKami.
Punchline: Adds row probabilities to the Wondrous Tails display.
